title: Chiune Sugihara Memorial Hall
geometryBasis: The L-shaped OSM plan and parking edge fix the tall eastern rectangle and attached low western roofs. Both original Qualla photos show the main north door facing the parking approach with the low wing extending to its west.
sectionBasis: The town’s municipal facility plan records a two-story wood building of 293.7 square metres completed in 2000. The operator identifies Gifu hinoki timber. The exact Qualla photos fix the projecting gable and angled timber lattice, glazed upper gable and lower wood wing.
limitations: Exterior of the memorial hall and attached low wing. Detached park features, interpretive plaques, interiors and landscaping are outside this asset.
The map fixes the building plan. Roof levels, individual windows and timber spacing are estimates from the two closely spaced photograph angles.
